goal: A single 4x3 grid showcasing 12 packable, theme-store-level app icons, with English tags of two to eight letters positioned below the icons.
theme: Personal efficiency combined with light entertainment (no real Apple or third-party trademarks).

style.rendering: Skeuomorphic 3D + soft light + 1px top edge highlight + deep soft shadows
style.material: Glass highlight layer + stainless steel brushed + small amounts of leather and UV light on paper
style.color_palette: Cream gray background + sky blue + signal green + soft orange + graphite black.
style.shape_base: Rounded Square with Approximately 24% Roundness, Isometric from the Same Angle

layout.background: Light linen paper texture or light gray fabric texture, no strong patterns.

icons.concept: Cowhide envelope slightly open revealing a corner of white stationery + red wax seal
icons.label: Mail

icons.concept: Metal ring calendar flipped to today + red round pin.
icons.label: Cal

icons.concept: Yellow notepad + dark gray pencil lying horizontally
icons.label: Notes

icons.concept: Vintage silver rangefinder body + large glass coated reflection
icons.label: Camera

icons.concept: Vinyl record half out of paper sleeve + orange center label
icons.label: Music

icons.concept: Origami map + red pushpin + slightly raised terrain
icons.label: Maps

icons.concept: Half-sphere cloud map + small sun + rain droplet overlay can be switched
icons.label: Weather

icons.concept: White calculator buttons with pressable feel + small LCD with green reflection
icons.label: Calc

icons.concept: Brown stitched leather wallet + a corner of a card exposed.
icons.label: Wallet

must_keep: 12 cards with the same main light in the upper left 45°, aligned to the same bottom edge
The total number of colors does not exceed 6 main colors + black, white, and gray
avoid: 1:1 collision with the iOS official icon
Information density in a single cell is too high
